_ww-text_text.en: One place for seller, buyer, title, lender and team conversations.
Subject, sender, property, seller/buyer link and attachments
Conversation thread tied to contact and property
Seller follow-up, title request, buyer blast, appointment confirmation
Every touch becomes part of the CRM timeline
Keep drafts safe until provider/API is connected
Turn any message into a follow-up item
• Gmail/Outlook can feed the communication center later
• Do not store API secrets in visible page code
• Use secure backend middleware for Podio and messaging credentials
LIVE DATA: activates when Podio / provider connectors are authorized.
